task_description: Phase 6 of migrating all persistence in a .NET 8 WPF worship app from JSON to SQLite: mirror the SONGS and SETLISTS stores into the shared app.db via AppDatabase, following the Phase-5 MIRROR pattern. JSON song.json files, audio stems, song.json.N backups, and _song_registry.json stay authoritative on disk; app.db gets a reconciled Songs table and a Setlists table. All public APIs preserved byte-for-byte, FolderPath identity intact, all tests green.
